children.name: autovacuum
children.short_desc: Starts the autovacuum subprocess.

children.name: autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor
children.short_desc: Number of tuple inserts, updates, or deletes prior to analyze as a fraction of reltuples.

children.name: autovacuum_analyze_threshold
children.short_desc: Minimum number of tuple inserts, updates, or deletes prior to analyze.

children.name: autovacuum_freeze_max_age
children.short_desc: Age at which to autovacuum a table to prevent transaction ID wraparound.

children.name: autovacuum_max_workers
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously running autovacuum worker processes.

children.name: autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age
children.short_desc: Multixact age at which to autovacuum a table to prevent multixact wraparound.

children.name: autovacuum_naptime
children.short_desc: Time to sleep between autovacuum runs.

children.name: autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay
children.short_desc: Vacuum cost delay in milliseconds, for autovacuum.

children.name: autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit
children.short_desc: Vacuum cost amount available before napping, for autovacuum.

children.name: autovacuum_vacuum_insert_scale_factor
children.short_desc: Number of tuple inserts prior to vacuum as a fraction of reltuples.

children.name: autovacuum_vacuum_insert_threshold
children.short_desc: Minimum number of tuple inserts prior to vacuum, or -1 to disable insert vacuums.

children.name: autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor
children.short_desc: Number of tuple updates or deletes prior to vacuum as a fraction of reltuples.

children.name: autovacuum_vacuum_threshold
children.short_desc: Minimum number of tuple updates or deletes prior to vacuum.

children.name: Locale and Formatting
children.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting

children.name: client_encoding
children.short_desc: Sets the client's character set encoding.

children.name: DateStyle
children.extra_desc: Also controls interpretation of ambiguous date inputs.
children.short_desc: Sets the display format for date and time values.

children.name: default_text_search_config
children.short_desc: Sets default text search configuration.

children.name: extra_float_digits
children.extra_desc: This affects real, double precision, and geometric data types. A zero or negative parameter value is added to the standard number of digits (FLT_DIG or DBL_DIG as appropriate). Any value greater than zero selects precise output mode.
children.short_desc: Sets the number of digits displayed for floating-point values.

children.name: icu_validation_level
children.short_desc: Log level for reporting invalid ICU locale strings.

children.name: IntervalStyle
children.short_desc: Sets the display format for interval values.

children.name: lc_messages
children.short_desc: Sets the language in which messages are displayed.

children.name: lc_monetary
children.short_desc: Sets the locale for formatting monetary amounts.

children.name: lc_numeric
children.short_desc: Sets the locale for formatting numbers.

children.name: lc_time
children.short_desc: Sets the locale for formatting date and time values.

children.name: TimeZone
children.short_desc: Sets the time zone for displaying and interpreting time stamps.

children.name: timezone_abbreviations
children.short_desc: Selects a file of time zone abbreviations.

children.name: dynamic_library_path
children.extra_desc: If a dynamically loadable module needs to be opened and the specified name does not have a directory component (i.e., the name does not contain a slash), the system will search this path for the specified file.
children.short_desc: Sets the path for dynamically loadable modules.

children.name: gin_fuzzy_search_limit
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed result for exact search by GIN.

children.name: Shared Library Preloading
children.category: Client Connection Defaults / Shared Library Preloading

children.name: jit_provider
children.short_desc: JIT provider to use.

children.name: local_preload_libraries
children.short_desc: Lists unprivileged shared libraries to preload into each backend.

children.name: session_preload_libraries
children.short_desc: Lists shared libraries to preload into each backend.

children.name: shared_preload_libraries
children.short_desc: Lists shared libraries to preload into server.

children.name: bytea_output
children.short_desc: Sets the output format for bytea.

children.name: check_function_bodies
children.short_desc: Check routine bodies during CREATE FUNCTION and CREATE PROCEDURE.

children.name: client_min_messages
children.extra_desc: Each level includes all the levels that follow it. The later the level, the fewer messages are sent.
children.short_desc: Sets the message levels that are sent to the client.

children.name: createrole_self_grant
children.short_desc: Sets whether a CREATEROLE user automatically grants the role to themselves, and with which options.

children.name: default_table_access_method
children.short_desc: Sets the default table access method for new tables.

children.name: default_tablespace
children.extra_desc: An empty string selects the database's default tablespace.
children.short_desc: Sets the default tablespace to create tables and indexes in.

children.name: default_toast_compression
children.short_desc: Sets the default compression method for compressible values.

children.name: default_transaction_deferrable
children.short_desc: Sets the default deferrable status of new transactions.

children.name: default_transaction_isolation
children.short_desc: Sets the transaction isolation level of each new transaction.

children.name: default_transaction_read_only
children.short_desc: Sets the default read-only status of new transactions.

children.name: gin_pending_list_limit
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum size of the pending list for GIN index.

children.name: idle_in_transaction_session_timeout
children.extra_desc: A value of 0 turns off the timeout.
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed idle time between queries, when in a transaction.

children.name: idle_session_timeout
children.extra_desc: A value of 0 turns off the timeout.
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed idle time between queries, when not in a transaction.

children.name: lock_timeout
children.extra_desc: A value of 0 turns off the timeout.
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed duration of any wait for a lock.

children.name: restrict_nonsystem_relation_kind
children.short_desc: Prohibits access to non-system relations of specified kinds.

children.name: row_security
children.extra_desc: When enabled, row security will be applied to all users.
children.short_desc: Enable row security.

children.name: search_path
children.short_desc: Sets the schema search order for names that are not schema-qualified.

children.name: session_replication_role
children.short_desc: Sets the session's behavior for triggers and rewrite rules.

children.name: statement_timeout
children.extra_desc: A value of 0 turns off the timeout.
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed duration of any statement.

children.name: temp_tablespaces
children.short_desc: Sets the tablespace(s) to use for temporary tables and sort files.

children.name: transaction_deferrable
children.short_desc: Whether to defer a read-only serializable transaction until it can be executed with no possible serialization failures.

children.name: transaction_isolation
children.short_desc: Sets the current transaction's isolation level.

children.name: transaction_read_only
children.short_desc: Sets the current transaction's read-only status.

children.name: vacuum_failsafe_age
children.short_desc: Age at which VACUUM should trigger failsafe to avoid a wraparound outage.

children.name: vacuum_freeze_min_age
children.short_desc: Minimum age at which VACUUM should freeze a table row.

children.name: vacuum_freeze_table_age
children.short_desc: Age at which VACUUM should scan whole table to freeze tuples.

children.name: vacuum_multixact_failsafe_age
children.short_desc: Multixact age at which VACUUM should trigger failsafe to avoid a wraparound outage.

children.name: vacuum_multixact_freeze_min_age
children.short_desc: Minimum age at which VACUUM should freeze a MultiXactId in a table row.

children.name: vacuum_multixact_freeze_table_age
children.short_desc: Multixact age at which VACUUM should scan whole table to freeze tuples.

children.name: xmlbinary
children.short_desc: Sets how binary values are to be encoded in XML.

children.name: xmloption
children.short_desc: Sets whether XML data in implicit parsing and serialization operations is to be considered as documents or content fragments.

children.name: authentication_timeout
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed time to complete client authentication.

children.name: db_user_namespace
children.short_desc: Enables per-database user names.

children.name: gss_accept_delegation
children.short_desc: Sets whether GSSAPI delegation should be accepted from the client.

children.name: krb_caseins_users
children.short_desc: Sets whether Kerberos and GSSAPI user names should be treated as case-insensitive.

children.name: krb_server_keyfile
children.short_desc: Sets the location of the Kerberos server key file.

children.name: password_encryption
children.short_desc: Chooses the algorithm for encrypting passwords.

children.name: scram_iterations
children.short_desc: Sets the iteration count for SCRAM secret generation.

children.name: bonjour
children.short_desc: Enables advertising the server via Bonjour.

children.name: bonjour_name
children.short_desc: Sets the Bonjour service name.

children.name: listen_addresses
children.short_desc: Sets the host name or IP address(es) to listen to.

children.name: max_connections
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of concurrent connections.

children.name: port
children.short_desc: Sets the TCP port the server listens on.

children.name: reserved_connections
children.short_desc: Sets the number of connection slots reserved for roles with privileges of pg_use_reserved_connections.

children.name: superuser_reserved_connections
children.short_desc: Sets the number of connection slots reserved for superusers.

children.name: unix_socket_directories
children.short_desc: Sets the directories where Unix-domain sockets will be created.

children.name: unix_socket_group
children.extra_desc: The owning user of the socket is always the user that starts the server.
children.short_desc: Sets the owning group of the Unix-domain socket.

children.name: unix_socket_permissions
children.extra_desc: Unix-domain sockets use the usual Unix file system permission set. The parameter value is expected to be a numeric mode specification in the form accepted by the chmod and umask system calls. (To use the customary octal format the number must start with a 0 (zero).)
children.short_desc: Sets the access permissions of the Unix-domain socket.

children.name: ssl
children.short_desc: Enables SSL connections.

children.name: ssl_ca_file
children.short_desc: Location of the SSL certificate authority file.

children.name: ssl_cert_file
children.short_desc: Location of the SSL server certificate file.

children.name: ssl_ciphers
children.short_desc: Sets the list of allowed SSL ciphers.

children.name: ssl_crl_dir
children.short_desc: Location of the SSL certificate revocation list directory.

children.name: ssl_crl_file
children.short_desc: Location of the SSL certificate revocation list file.

children.name: ssl_dh_params_file
children.short_desc: Location of the SSL DH parameters file.

children.name: ssl_ecdh_curve
children.short_desc: Sets the curve to use for ECDH.

children.name: ssl_key_file
children.short_desc: Location of the SSL server private key file.

children.name: ssl_max_protocol_version
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum SSL/TLS protocol version to use.

children.name: ssl_min_protocol_version
children.short_desc: Sets the minimum SSL/TLS protocol version to use.

children.name: ssl_passphrase_command
children.short_desc: Command to obtain passphrases for SSL.

children.name: ssl_passphrase_command_supports_reload
children.short_desc: Controls whether ssl_passphrase_command is called during server reload.

children.name: ssl_prefer_server_ciphers
children.short_desc: Give priority to server ciphersuite order.

children.name: client_connection_check_interval
children.short_desc: Sets the time interval between checks for disconnection while running queries.

children.name: tcp_keepalives_count
children.extra_desc: Number of consecutive keepalive retransmits that can be lost before a connection is considered dead. A value of 0 uses the system default.
children.short_desc: Maximum number of TCP keepalive retransmits.

children.name: tcp_keepalives_idle
children.extra_desc: A value of 0 uses the system default.
children.short_desc: Time between issuing TCP keepalives.

children.name: tcp_keepalives_interval
children.extra_desc: A value of 0 uses the system default.
children.short_desc: Time between TCP keepalive retransmits.

children.name: tcp_user_timeout
children.extra_desc: A value of 0 uses the system default.
children.short_desc: TCP user timeout.

children.name: allow_in_place_tablespaces
children.short_desc: Allows tablespaces directly inside pg_tblspc, for testing.

children.name: allow_system_table_mods
children.short_desc: Allows modifications of the structure of system tables.

children.name: backtrace_functions
children.short_desc: Log backtrace for errors in these functions.

children.name: debug_discard_caches
children.short_desc: Aggressively flush system caches for debugging purposes.

children.name: debug_io_direct
children.short_desc: Use direct I/O for file access.

children.name: debug_logical_replication_streaming
children.extra_desc: On the publisher, it allows streaming or serializing each change in logical decoding. On the subscriber, it allows serialization of all changes to files and notifies the parallel apply workers to read and apply them at the end of the transaction.
children.short_desc: Forces immediate streaming or serialization of changes in large transactions.

children.name: debug_parallel_query
children.extra_desc: This can be useful for testing the parallel query infrastructure by forcing the planner to generate plans that contain nodes that perform tuple communication between workers and the main process.
children.short_desc: Forces the planner's use parallel query nodes.

children.name: ignore_checksum_failure
children.extra_desc: Detection of a checksum failure normally causes PostgreSQL to report an error, aborting the current transaction. Setting ignore_checksum_failure to true causes the system to ignore the failure (but still report a warning), and continue processing. This behavior could cause crashes or other serious problems. Only has an effect if checksums are enabled.
children.short_desc: Continues processing after a checksum failure.

children.name: ignore_invalid_pages
children.extra_desc: Detection of WAL records having references to invalid pages during recovery causes PostgreSQL to raise a PANIC-level error, aborting the recovery. Setting ignore_invalid_pages to true causes the system to ignore invalid page references in WAL records (but still report a warning), and continue recovery. This behavior may cause crashes, data loss, propagate or hide corruption, or other serious problems. Only has an effect during recovery or in standby mode.
children.short_desc: Continues recovery after an invalid pages failure.

children.name: ignore_system_indexes
children.extra_desc: It does not prevent updating the indexes, so it is safe to use.  The worst consequence is slowness.
children.short_desc: Disables reading from system indexes.

children.name: jit_debugging_support
children.short_desc: Register JIT-compiled functions with debugger.

children.name: jit_dump_bitcode
children.short_desc: Write out LLVM bitcode to facilitate JIT debugging.

children.name: jit_expressions
children.short_desc: Allow JIT compilation of expressions.

children.name: jit_profiling_support
children.short_desc: Register JIT-compiled functions with perf profiler.

children.name: jit_tuple_deforming
children.short_desc: Allow JIT compilation of tuple deforming.

children.name: post_auth_delay
children.extra_desc: This allows attaching a debugger to the process.
children.short_desc: Sets the amount of time to wait after authentication on connection startup.

children.name: pre_auth_delay
children.extra_desc: This allows attaching a debugger to the process.
children.short_desc: Sets the amount of time to wait before authentication on connection startup.

children.name: remove_temp_files_after_crash
children.short_desc: Remove temporary files after backend crash.

children.name: send_abort_for_crash
children.short_desc: Send SIGABRT not SIGQUIT to child processes after backend crash.

children.name: send_abort_for_kill
children.short_desc: Send SIGABRT not SIGKILL to stuck child processes.

children.name: trace_notify
children.short_desc: Generates debugging output for LISTEN and NOTIFY.

children.name: trace_recovery_messages
children.extra_desc: Each level includes all the levels that follow it. The later the level, the fewer messages are sent.
children.short_desc: Enables logging of recovery-related debugging information.

children.name: trace_sort
children.short_desc: Emit information about resource usage in sorting.

children.name: wal_consistency_checking
children.extra_desc: Full-page images will be logged for all data blocks and cross-checked against the results of WAL replay.
children.short_desc: Sets the WAL resource managers for which WAL consistency checks are done.

children.name: zero_damaged_pages
children.extra_desc: Detection of a damaged page header normally causes PostgreSQL to report an error, aborting the current transaction. Setting zero_damaged_pages to true causes the system to instead report a warning, zero out the damaged page, and continue processing. This behavior will destroy data, namely all the rows on the damaged page.
children.short_desc: Continues processing past damaged page headers.

children.name: data_sync_retry
children.short_desc: Whether to continue running after a failure to sync data files.

children.name: exit_on_error
children.short_desc: Terminate session on any error.

children.name: recovery_init_sync_method
children.short_desc: Sets the method for synchronizing the data directory before crash recovery.

children.name: restart_after_crash
children.short_desc: Reinitialize server after backend crash.

children.name: config_file
children.short_desc: Sets the server's main configuration file.

children.name: data_directory
children.short_desc: Sets the server's data directory.

children.name: external_pid_file
children.short_desc: Writes the postmaster PID to the specified file.

children.name: hba_file
children.short_desc: Sets the server's "hba" configuration file.

children.name: ident_file
children.short_desc: Sets the server's "ident" configuration file.

children.name: deadlock_timeout
children.short_desc: Sets the time to wait on a lock before checking for deadlock.

children.name: max_locks_per_transaction
children.extra_desc: The shared lock table is sized on the assumption that at most max_locks_per_transaction objects per server process or prepared transaction will need to be locked at any one time.
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of locks per transaction.

children.name: max_pred_locks_per_page
children.extra_desc: If more than this number of tuples on the same page are locked by a connection, those locks are replaced by a page-level lock.
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of predicate-locked tuples per page.

children.name: max_pred_locks_per_relation
children.extra_desc: If more than this total of pages and tuples in the same relation are locked by a connection, those locks are replaced by a relation-level lock.
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of predicate-locked pages and tuples per relation.

children.name: max_pred_locks_per_transaction
children.extra_desc: The shared predicate lock table is sized on the assumption that at most max_pred_locks_per_transaction objects per server process or prepared transaction will need to be locked at any one time.
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of predicate locks per transaction.

children.name: block_size
children.short_desc: Shows the size of a disk block.

children.name: data_checksums
children.short_desc: Shows whether data checksums are turned on for this cluster.

children.name: data_directory_mode
children.extra_desc: The parameter value is a numeric mode specification in the form accepted by the chmod and umask system calls. (To use the customary octal format the number must start with a 0 (zero).)
children.short_desc: Shows the mode of the data directory.

children.name: debug_assertions
children.short_desc: Shows whether the running server has assertion checks enabled.

children.name: in_hot_standby
children.short_desc: Shows whether hot standby is currently active.

children.name: integer_datetimes
children.short_desc: Shows whether datetimes are integer based.

children.name: max_function_args
children.short_desc: Shows the maximum number of function arguments.

children.name: max_identifier_length
children.short_desc: Shows the maximum identifier length.

children.name: max_index_keys
children.short_desc: Shows the maximum number of index keys.

children.name: segment_size
children.short_desc: Shows the number of pages per disk file.

children.name: server_encoding
children.short_desc: Shows the server (database) character set encoding.

children.name: server_version
children.short_desc: Shows the server version.

children.name: server_version_num
children.short_desc: Shows the server version as an integer.

children.name: shared_memory_size
children.short_desc: Shows the size of the server's main shared memory area (rounded up to the nearest MB).

children.name: shared_memory_size_in_huge_pages
children.extra_desc: -1 indicates that the value could not be determined.
children.short_desc: Shows the number of huge pages needed for the main shared memory area.

children.name: ssl_library
children.short_desc: Shows the name of the SSL library.

children.name: wal_block_size
children.short_desc: Shows the block size in the write ahead log.

children.name: wal_segment_size
children.short_desc: Shows the size of write ahead log segments.

children.name: autonomous_pool_capacity
children.extra_desc: A value of 0 disables the autonomous transactions.
children.short_desc: Maximal number of autonomous sessions in use at the same time.

children.name: autonomous_session_max_uses
children.short_desc: Maximum number of uses of autonomous session.

children.name: integrity_checks
children.short_desc: Enable QHB integrity checks

children.name: integrity_period
children.short_desc: Period of QHB integrity check

children.name: license_warning_gap
children.short_desc: Time gap period for lincense expiry warnings.

children.name: license_warning_period
children.short_desc: lincense expiry warnings frequency.

children.name: logon_jobs
children.short_desc: Enable QHB logon jobs

children.name: mask_pg_version
children.short_desc: Mask true nature of QHB server

children.name: mask_version_template
children.extra_desc: Say {qv} for QHB version, {pv} for Postgres compartible version, {lv} for license information
children.short_desc: Overrides product version template

children.name: metrics_collector_path
children.extra_desc: Path to a unix domain socket. To use the anonymous namespace, prefix the path with @
children.short_desc: Sets the global collector UDS address.

children.name: optimized_snapshots
children.short_desc: Use optimized snapshots engine

children.name: qcdc_registry_size
children.short_desc: QCDC Registry size (in megabytes)

children.name: qhb_backtrace_max_age
children.short_desc: Period of storage for QHB backtrace files

children.name: qhb_backtrace_max_count
children.short_desc: Max count of stored QHB backtrace files

children.name: qhb_cache_size
children.short_desc: Sets the amount of shared memory used for QHB cache.

children.name: qhb_caching_while_scan
children.extra_desc: Cache seq_scan as other reads (0 -- no, 1 -- for seq_scan AM, 2 -- plus while collecting stats and similar).
children.short_desc: Cache seq_scan as other reads (when use_qhb_cache).

children.name: qhb_load_tzoffsets_cache_size_kb
children.short_desc: Sets the amount of shared memory (kilobytes) used for load_tzoffsets cache.

children.name: qhb_metrics_cache_size
children.short_desc: Sets the amount of shared memory used for metrics config runtime.

children.name: qhb_mq_map_size
children.short_desc: MQ internal map size (in megabytes)

children.name: qhb_onlymem_cache_size
children.short_desc: Sets the amount of shared memmory used for InMemory-ONLY mapping structures.

children.name: qhb_plan_cache_size
children.short_desc: Sets Quantum Plan Cache size in MB. If the value is 0, the cache will be disabled.

children.name: qhb_possible_buffers_size
children.short_desc: Sets the amount of possible buffers memory.

children.name: qhb_relopt_cache_size
children.short_desc: Sets the amount of shared memory used for HOLDMEM Relopt cache.

children.name: qsched_log_rotation_adjustment_period
children.short_desc: Specify the log rotation auto strategy adjustment period in seconds

children.name: qsched_log_rotation_max_entries
children.short_desc: Specify the log rotation period in the number of remaining log entries

children.name: qsched_log_rotation_max_lifetime
children.short_desc: Specify the log rotation period by the maximum age of the retained log entries

children.name: qsched_log_rotation_period
children.short_desc: Specify the log rotation period in '1d 1h 1m' format

children.name: qsched_log_rotation_strategy
children.short_desc: Specify the log rotation strategy

children.name: qss_encrypt_statistic
children.extra_desc: Statistic contains most common values of each column and similar stuff. Statistics of all tables will be encrypted, not only of QSS-tables.
children.short_desc: Encrypt table data statistics when qss_mode is ON

children.name: qss_mode
children.short_desc: Sets the server Quantum Secure Storage mode.

children.name: qss_shmem_size_cap
children.extra_desc: Memory usage starts from 8Kb anyway, but can grow up to this limit. Each backend has memory of its own. Larger BLOB can be encrypted, but memory allocated and deallocated for processing each one.
children.short_desc: Sets the memory reserved for communicating Quantum Secure Storage Server.

children.name: queryid_auto_register
children.short_desc: Register new queries automatically when executed

children.name: queryid_max_saved
children.short_desc: The maximal number of queries to store for metrics

children.name: queryid_update_threshold
children.short_desc: The time threshold after which update is allowed

children.name: query_profiling
children.short_desc: Enable query profiling.

children.name: query_profiling_queue_size
children.short_desc: Query profiling queue size (in megabytes)

children.name: resource_management
children.short_desc: Whether to enable the QHB resource manager.

children.name: wipe_file_on_delete
children.short_desc: Fill files with zeroes before deletion

children.name: wipe_heaptuple_on_delete
children.short_desc: Fill tuples with zeroes when deleted tuples are vacuumed

children.name: wipe_memctx_on_free
children.short_desc: Fill memory with zeroes when it is freed from a memory context

children.name: wipe_xlog_on_free
children.short_desc: Fill WAL segment with zeroes when it is deleted or to be reused

children.name: with_mq_broker
children.short_desc: Start with message queue broker

children.name: with_qsched
children.short_desc: Start with QSched scheduler

children.name: xml_ignore_encoding
children.short_desc: Force libXML to ignore encodings in some xml functions

children.name: geqo
children.extra_desc: This algorithm attempts to do planning without exhaustive searching.
children.short_desc: Enables genetic query optimization.

children.name: geqo_effort
children.short_desc: GEQO: effort is used to set the default for other GEQO parameters.

children.name: geqo_generations
children.extra_desc: Zero selects a suitable default value.
children.short_desc: GEQO: number of iterations of the algorithm.

children.name: geqo_pool_size
children.extra_desc: Zero selects a suitable default value.
children.short_desc: GEQO: number of individuals in the population.

children.name: geqo_seed
children.short_desc: GEQO: seed for random path selection.

children.name: geqo_selection_bias
children.short_desc: GEQO: selective pressure within the population.

children.name: geqo_threshold
children.short_desc: Sets the threshold of FROM items beyond which GEQO is used.

children.name: constraint_exclusion
children.extra_desc: Table scans will be skipped if their constraints guarantee that no rows match the query.
children.short_desc: Enables the planner to use constraints to optimize queries.

children.name: cursor_tuple_fraction
children.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the fraction of a cursor's rows that will be retrieved.

children.name: default_statistics_target
children.extra_desc: This applies to table columns that have not had a column-specific target set via ALTER TABLE SET STATISTICS.
children.short_desc: Sets the default statistics target.

children.name: from_collapse_limit
children.extra_desc: The planner will merge subqueries into upper queries if the resulting FROM list would have no more than this many items.
children.short_desc: Sets the FROM-list size beyond which subqueries are not collapsed.

children.name: jit
children.short_desc: Allow JIT compilation.

children.name: join_collapse_limit
children.extra_desc: The planner will flatten explicit JOIN constructs into lists of FROM items whenever a list of no more than this many items would result.
children.short_desc: Sets the FROM-list size beyond which JOIN constructs are not flattened.

children.name: online_analyze.capacity_threshold
children.extra_desc: Max local cache table capacity.
children.short_desc: Max local cache table capacity.

children.name: online_analyze.enable
children.extra_desc: Enables analyze of table directly after insert/update/delete/select into.
children.short_desc: Enable on-line analyze.

children.name: online_analyze.exclude_tables
children.short_desc: List of tables which will not online analyze.

children.name: online_analyze.include_tables
children.short_desc: List of tables which will online analyze.

children.name: online_analyze.local_tracking
children.extra_desc: Per backend tracking for temp tables (do not use system statistic).
children.short_desc: Per backend tracking.

children.name: online_analyze.lower_limit
children.extra_desc: Min number of rows in table to analyze.
children.short_desc: Min number of rows in table to analyze.

children.name: online_analyze.min_interval
children.extra_desc: Minimum time interval between analyze call (in milliseconds).
children.short_desc: Minimum time interval between analyze call (in milliseconds).

children.name: online_analyze.scale_factor
children.extra_desc: Fraction of table size to start on-line analyze.
children.short_desc: Fraction of table size to start on-line analyze.

children.name: online_analyze.table_type
children.short_desc: Type(s) of table for online analyze: all(default), persistent, temporary, none.

children.name: online_analyze.threshold
children.extra_desc: Min number of row updates before on-line analyze.
children.short_desc: Min number of row updates before on-line analyze.

children.name: online_analyze.verbose
children.extra_desc: Make ANALYZE VERBOSE after table's changes.
children.short_desc: Verbosity of on-line analyze.

children.name: plan_cache_mode
children.extra_desc: Prepared statements can have custom and generic plans, and the planner will attempt to choose which is better.  This can be set to override the default behavior.
children.short_desc: Controls the planner's selection of custom or generic plan.

children.name: plantuner.disable_index
children.extra_desc: Listed indexes will not be used in queries.
children.short_desc: List of disabled indexes.

children.name: plantuner.enable_index
children.extra_desc: Listed indexes which could be used in queries even they are listed in plantuner.disable_index
children.short_desc: List of enabled indexes (overload plantuner.disable_index).

children.name: plantuner.fix_empty_table
children.extra_desc: Sets to zero estimations for empty or newly created tables.
children.short_desc: Sets to zero estimations for empty tables.

children.name: plantuner.only_index
children.extra_desc: List of explicitly enabled indexes (overload plantuner.disable_index and plantuner.enable_index).
children.short_desc: Only indexes in this list are allowed.

children.name: qhb_os_monitoring
children.short_desc: OS statistics monitoring

children.name: recursive_worktable_factor
children.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the average size of a recursive query's working table.

children.name: cpu_index_tuple_cost
children.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of processing each index entry during an index scan.

children.name: cpu_operator_cost
children.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of processing each operator or function call.

children.name: cpu_tuple_cost
children.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of processing each tuple (row).

children.name: effective_cache_size
children.extra_desc: That is, the total size of the caches (kernel cache and shared buffers) used for PostgreSQL data files. This is measured in disk pages, which are normally 8 kB each.
children.short_desc: Sets the planner's assumption about the total size of the data caches.

children.name: jit_above_cost
children.extra_desc: -1 disables JIT compilation.
children.short_desc: Perform JIT compilation if query is more expensive.

children.name: jit_inline_above_cost
children.extra_desc: -1 disables inlining.
children.short_desc: Perform JIT inlining if query is more expensive.

children.name: jit_optimize_above_cost
children.extra_desc: -1 disables optimization.
children.short_desc: Optimize JIT-compiled functions if query is more expensive.

children.name: min_parallel_index_scan_size
children.extra_desc: If the planner estimates that it will read a number of index pages too small to reach this limit, a parallel scan will not be considered.
children.short_desc: Sets the minimum amount of index data for a parallel scan.

children.name: min_parallel_table_scan_size
children.extra_desc: If the planner estimates that it will read a number of table pages too small to reach this limit, a parallel scan will not be considered.
children.short_desc: Sets the minimum amount of table data for a parallel scan.

children.name: parallel_setup_cost
children.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of starting up worker processes for parallel query.

children.name: parallel_tuple_cost
children.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of passing each tuple (row) from worker to leader backend.

children.name: random_page_cost
children.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of a nonsequentially fetched disk page.

children.name: seq_page_cost
children.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of a sequentially fetched disk page.

children.name: enable_async_append
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of async append plans.

children.name: enable_backtrace
children.short_desc: Enables trace log (WARNING: disabling this will limit support or even make it impossible)

children.name: enable_bitmapscan
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of bitmap-scan plans.

children.name: enable_gathermerge
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of gather merge plans.

children.name: enable_hashagg
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of hashed aggregation plans.

children.name: enable_hashjoin
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of hash join plans.

children.name: enable_incremental_sort
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of incremental sort steps.

children.name: enable_indexonlyscan
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of index-only-scan plans.

children.name: enable_indexscan
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of index-scan plans.

children.name: enable_material
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of materialization.

children.name: enable_memoize
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of memoization.

children.name: enable_mergejoin
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of merge join plans.

children.name: enable_nestloop
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of nested-loop join plans.

children.name: enable_parallel_append
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of parallel append plans.

children.name: enable_parallel_hash
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of parallel hash plans.

children.name: enable_partition_pruning
children.extra_desc: Allows the query planner and executor to compare partition bounds to conditions in the query to determine which partitions must be scanned.
children.short_desc: Enables plan-time and execution-time partition pruning.

children.name: enable_partitionwise_aggregate
children.short_desc: Enables partitionwise aggregation and grouping.

children.name: enable_partitionwise_join
children.short_desc: Enables partitionwise join.

children.name: enable_presorted_aggregate
children.extra_desc: Allows the query planner to build plans that provide presorted input for aggregate functions with an ORDER BY / DISTINCT clause.  When disabled, implicit sorts are always performed during execution.
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's ability to produce plans that provide presorted input for ORDER BY / DISTINCT aggregate functions.

children.name: enable_seqscan
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of sequential-scan plans.

children.name: enable_sort
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of explicit sort steps.

children.name: enable_tidscan
children.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of TID scan plans.

children.name: synchronous_standby_names
children.short_desc: Number of synchronous standbys and list of names of potential synchronous ones.

children.name: max_replication_slots
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously defined replication slots.

children.name: max_slot_wal_keep_size
children.extra_desc: Replication slots will be marked as failed, and segments released for deletion or recycling, if this much space is occupied by WAL on disk.
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum WAL size that can be reserved by replication slots.

children.name: max_wal_senders
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously running WAL sender processes.

children.name: track_commit_timestamp
children.short_desc: Collects transaction commit time.

children.name: wal_keep_size
children.short_desc: Sets the size of WAL files held for standby servers.

children.name: wal_sender_timeout
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum time to wait for WAL replication.

children.name: hot_standby
children.short_desc: Allows connections and queries during recovery.

children.name: hot_standby_feedback
children.short_desc: Allows feedback from a hot standby to the primary that will avoid query conflicts.

children.name: max_standby_archive_delay
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum delay before canceling queries when a hot standby server is processing archived WAL data.

children.name: max_standby_streaming_delay
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum delay before canceling queries when a hot standby server is processing streamed WAL data.

children.name: primary_conninfo
children.short_desc: Sets the connection string to be used to connect to the sending server.

children.name: primary_slot_name
children.short_desc: Sets the name of the replication slot to use on the sending server.

children.name: recovery_min_apply_delay
children.short_desc: Sets the minimum delay for applying changes during recovery.

children.name: wal_receiver_create_temp_slot
children.short_desc: Sets whether a WAL receiver should create a temporary replication slot if no permanent slot is configured.

children.name: wal_receiver_status_interval
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum interval between WAL receiver status reports to the sending server.

children.name: wal_receiver_timeout
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum wait time to receive data from the sending server.

children.name: wal_retrieve_retry_interval
children.short_desc: Sets the time to wait before retrying to retrieve WAL after a failed attempt.

children.name: max_logical_replication_workers
children.short_desc: Maximum number of logical replication worker processes.

children.name: max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription
children.short_desc: Maximum number of parallel apply workers per subscription.

children.name: max_sync_workers_per_subscription
children.short_desc: Maximum number of table synchronization workers per subscription.

children.name: cluster_name
children.short_desc: Sets the name of the instance, which is included in the process title.

children.name: instance_name
children.short_desc: Sets the name of the instance, which is included in the process title.

children.name: update_process_title
children.extra_desc: Enables updating of the process title every time a new SQL command is received by the server.
children.short_desc: Updates the process title to show the active SQL command.

children.name: What to Log
children.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log

children.name: application_name
children.short_desc: Sets the application name to be reported in statistics and logs.

children.name: debug_pretty_print
children.short_desc: Indents parse and plan tree displays.

children.name: debug_print_parse
children.short_desc: Logs each query's parse tree.

children.name: debug_print_plan
children.short_desc: Logs each query's execution plan.

children.name: debug_print_rewritten
children.short_desc: Logs each query's rewritten parse tree.

children.name: log_autovacuum_min_duration
children.extra_desc: Zero prints all actions. -1 turns autovacuum logging off.
children.short_desc: Sets the minimum execution time above which autovacuum actions will be logged.

children.name: log_checkpoint_progress
children.short_desc: Logs checkpoint progress.

children.name: log_checkpoints
children.short_desc: Logs each checkpoint.

children.name: log_connections
children.short_desc: Logs each successful connection.

children.name: log_disconnections
children.short_desc: Logs end of a session, including duration.

children.name: log_duration
children.short_desc: Logs the duration of each completed SQL statement.

children.name: log_error_verbosity
children.short_desc: Sets the verbosity of logged messages.

children.name: log_hostname
children.extra_desc: By default, connection logs only show the IP address of the connecting host. If you want them to show the host name you can turn this on, but depending on your host name resolution setup it might impose a non-negligible performance penalty.
children.short_desc: Logs the host name in the connection logs.

children.name: log_line_prefix
children.extra_desc: If blank, no prefix is used.
children.short_desc: Controls information prefixed to each log line.

children.name: log_lock_waits
children.short_desc: Logs long lock waits.

children.name: log_parameter_max_length
children.extra_desc: -1 to print values in full.
children.short_desc: When logging statements, limit logged parameter values to first N bytes.

children.name: log_parameter_max_length_on_error
children.extra_desc: -1 to print values in full.
children.short_desc: When reporting an error, limit logged parameter values to first N bytes.

children.name: log_recovery_conflict_waits
children.short_desc: Logs standby recovery conflict waits.

children.name: log_replication_commands
children.short_desc: Logs each replication command.

children.name: log_statement
children.short_desc: Sets the type of statements logged.

children.name: log_temp_files
children.extra_desc: Zero logs all files. The default is -1 (turning this feature off).
children.short_desc: Log the use of temporary files larger than this number of kilobytes.

children.name: log_timezone
children.short_desc: Sets the time zone to use in log messages.

children.name: When to Log
children.category: Reporting and Logging / When to Log

children.name: backtrace_min_messages
children.short_desc: Min error-level to generate trace (as a separate file on server).

children.name: log_min_duration_sample
children.extra_desc: Zero logs a sample of all queries. -1 turns this feature off.
children.short_desc: Sets the minimum execution time above which a sample of statements will be logged. Sampling is determined by log_statement_sample_rate.

children.name: log_min_duration_statement
children.extra_desc: Zero prints all queries. -1 turns this feature off.
children.short_desc: Sets the minimum execution time above which all statements will be logged.

children.name: log_min_error_statement
children.extra_desc: Each level includes all the levels that follow it. The later the level, the fewer messages are sent.
children.short_desc: Causes all statements generating error at or above this level to be logged.

children.name: log_min_messages
children.extra_desc: Each level includes all the levels that follow it. The later the level, the fewer messages are sent.
children.short_desc: Sets the message levels that are logged.

children.name: log_startup_progress_interval
children.extra_desc: 0 turns this feature off.
children.short_desc: Time between progress updates for long-running startup operations.

children.name: log_statement_sample_rate
children.extra_desc: Use a value between 0.0 (never log) and 1.0 (always log).
children.short_desc: Fraction of statements exceeding log_min_duration_sample to be logged.

children.name: log_transaction_sample_rate
children.extra_desc: Use a value between 0.0 (never log) and 1.0 (log all statements for all transactions).
children.short_desc: Sets the fraction of transactions from which to log all statements.

children.name: Where to Log
children.category: Reporting and Logging / Where to Log

children.name: event_source
children.short_desc: Sets the application name used to identify QHB messages in the event log.

children.name: log_destination
children.extra_desc: Valid values are combinations of "stderr", "syslog", "csvlog", "jsonlog", and "eventlog", depending on the platform.
children.short_desc: Sets the destination for server log output.

children.name: log_directory
children.extra_desc: Can be specified as relative to the data directory or as absolute path.
children.short_desc: Sets the destination directory for log files.

children.name: log_file_mode
children.extra_desc: The parameter value is expected to be a numeric mode specification in the form accepted by the chmod and umask system calls. (To use the customary octal format the number must start with a 0 (zero).)
children.short_desc: Sets the file permissions for log files.

children.name: log_filename
children.short_desc: Sets the file name pattern for log files.

children.name: logging_collector
children.short_desc: Start a subprocess to capture stderr, csvlog and/or jsonlog into log files.

children.name: log_rotation_age
children.short_desc: Sets the amount of time to wait before forcing log file rotation.

children.name: log_rotation_size
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum size a log file can reach before being rotated.

children.name: log_truncate_on_rotation
children.short_desc: Truncate existing log files of same name during log rotation.

children.name: syslog_facility
children.short_desc: Sets the syslog "facility" to be used when syslog enabled.

children.name: syslog_ident
children.short_desc: Sets the program name used to identify QHB messages in syslog.

children.name: syslog_sequence_numbers
children.short_desc: Add sequence number to syslog messages to avoid duplicate suppression.

children.name: syslog_split_messages
children.short_desc: Split messages sent to syslog by lines and to fit into 1024 bytes.

children.name: backend_flush_after
children.short_desc: Number of pages after which previously performed writes are flushed to disk.

children.name: effective_io_concurrency
children.short_desc: Number of simultaneous requests that can be handled efficiently by the disk subsystem.

children.name: maintenance_io_concurrency
children.short_desc: A variant of effective_io_concurrency that is used for maintenance work.

children.name: max_parallel_maintenance_workers
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of parallel processes per maintenance operation.

children.name: max_parallel_workers
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of parallel workers that can be active at one time.

children.name: max_parallel_workers_per_gather
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of parallel processes per executor node.

children.name: max_worker_processes
children.short_desc: Maximum number of concurrent worker processes.

children.name: old_snapshot_threshold
children.extra_desc: A value of -1 disables this feature.
children.short_desc: Time before a snapshot is too old to read pages changed after the snapshot was taken.

children.name: parallel_leader_participation
children.extra_desc: Should gather nodes also run subplans or just gather tuples?
children.short_desc: Controls whether Gather and Gather Merge also run subplans.

children.name: qsched_parallel_slaves
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of parallel QSched slaves per DB

children.name: bgwriter_delay
children.short_desc: Background writer sleep time between rounds.

children.name: bgwriter_flush_after
children.short_desc: Number of pages after which previously performed writes are flushed to disk.

children.name: bgwriter_lru_maxpages
children.short_desc: Background writer maximum number of LRU pages to flush per round.

children.name: bgwriter_lru_multiplier
children.short_desc: Multiple of the average buffer usage to free per round.

children.name: vacuum_cost_delay
children.short_desc: Vacuum cost delay in milliseconds.

children.name: vacuum_cost_limit
children.short_desc: Vacuum cost amount available before napping.

children.name: vacuum_cost_page_dirty
children.short_desc: Vacuum cost for a page dirtied by vacuum.

children.name: vacuum_cost_page_hit
children.short_desc: Vacuum cost for a page found in the buffer cache.

children.name: vacuum_cost_page_miss
children.short_desc: Vacuum cost for a page not found in the buffer cache.

children.name: temp_file_limit
children.extra_desc: -1 means no limit.
children.short_desc: Limits the total size of all temporary files used by each process.

children.name: max_files_per_process
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously open files for each server process.

children.name: autovacuum_work_mem
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum memory to be used by each autovacuum worker process.

children.name: dynamic_shared_memory_type
children.short_desc: Selects the dynamic shared memory implementation used.

children.name: hash_mem_multiplier
children.short_desc: Multiple of work_mem to use for hash tables.

children.name: huge_pages
children.short_desc: Use of huge pages on Linux or Windows.

children.name: huge_page_size
children.short_desc: The size of huge page that should be requested.

children.name: logical_decoding_work_mem
children.extra_desc: This much memory can be used by each internal reorder buffer before spilling to disk.
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum memory to be used for logical decoding.

children.name: maintenance_work_mem
children.extra_desc: This includes operations such as VACUUM and CREATE INDEX.
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum memory to be used for maintenance operations.

children.name: max_prepared_transactions
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously prepared transactions.

children.name: max_stack_depth
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum stack depth, in kilobytes.

children.name: min_dynamic_shared_memory
children.short_desc: Amount of dynamic shared memory reserved at startup.

children.name: onlymem_buffers
children.short_desc: Sets the number of shared memory buffers used for InMemory-ONLY tables and indices.

children.name: possible_buffers
children.short_desc: Sets the number of shared memory buffers used by the server.

children.name: query_stat_mem
children.short_desc: Memory for qhb_query_stat view.

children.name: shared_buffers
children.short_desc: Sets the number of shared memory buffers used by the server.

children.name: shared_buffers_partitions
children.short_desc: Sets the number of shared memory buffers partitions.

children.name: shared_memory_type
children.short_desc: Selects the shared memory implementation used for the main shared memory region.

children.name: temp_buffers
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of temporary buffers used by each session.

children.name: use_possible_buffer
children.short_desc: Use possible buffer.

children.name: use_qhb_cache
children.short_desc: Use new buffer strategy.

children.name: use_qhb_onlymem_cache
children.short_desc: Use InMemory-ONLY storage.

children.name: vacuum_buffer_usage_limit
children.short_desc: Sets the buffer pool size for VACUUM, ANALYZE, and autovacuum.

children.name: work_mem
children.extra_desc: This much memory can be used by each internal sort operation and hash table before switching to temporary disk files.
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum memory to be used for query workspaces.

children.name: Cumulative Query and Index Statistics
children.category: Statistics / Cumulative Query and Index Statistics

children.name: stats_fetch_consistency
children.short_desc: Sets the consistency of accesses to statistics data.

children.name: track_activities
children.extra_desc: Enables the collection of information on the currently executing command of each session, along with the time at which that command began execution.
children.short_desc: Collects information about executing commands.

children.name: track_activity_query_size
children.short_desc: Sets the size reserved for pg_stat_activity.query, in bytes.

children.name: track_counts
children.short_desc: Collects statistics on database activity.

children.name: track_functions
children.short_desc: Collects function-level statistics on database activity.

children.name: track_io_timing
children.short_desc: Collects timing statistics for database I/O activity.

children.name: track_wal_io_timing
children.short_desc: Collects timing statistics for WAL I/O activity.

children.name: compute_query_id
children.short_desc: Enables in-core computation of query identifiers.

children.name: log_executor_stats
children.short_desc: Writes executor performance statistics to the server log.

children.name: log_parser_stats
children.short_desc: Writes parser performance statistics to the server log.

children.name: log_planner_stats
children.short_desc: Writes planner performance statistics to the server log.

children.name: log_statement_stats
children.short_desc: Writes cumulative performance statistics to the server log.

children.name: qhb_os_stat_period
children.short_desc: External statistic gather period (in seconds).

children.name: dbalias
children.short_desc: dbalias parameter has format source_db:destination_db.

children.name: Other Platforms and Clients
children.category: Version and Platform Compatibility / Other Platforms and Clients

children.name: transform_null_equals
children.extra_desc: When turned on, expressions of the form expr = NULL (or NULL = expr) are treated as expr IS NULL, that is, they return true if expr evaluates to the null value, and false otherwise. The correct behavior of expr = NULL is to always return null (unknown).
children.short_desc: Treats "expr=NULL" as "expr IS NULL".

children.name: Previous PostgreSQL Versions
children.category: Version and Platform Compatibility / Previous PostgreSQL Versions

children.name: array_nulls
children.extra_desc: When turned on, unquoted NULL in an array input value means a null value; otherwise it is taken literally.
children.short_desc: Enable input of NULL elements in arrays.

children.name: backslash_quote
children.short_desc: Sets whether "\'" is allowed in string literals.

children.name: escape_string_warning
children.short_desc: Warn about backslash escapes in ordinary string literals.

children.name: lo_compat_privileges
children.extra_desc: Skips privilege checks when reading or modifying large objects, for compatibility with PostgreSQL releases prior to 9.0.
children.short_desc: Enables backward compatibility mode for privilege checks on large objects.

children.name: quote_all_identifiers
children.short_desc: When generating SQL fragments, quote all identifiers.

children.name: standard_conforming_strings
children.short_desc: Causes '...' strings to treat backslashes literally.

children.name: synchronize_seqscans
children.short_desc: Enable synchronized sequential scans.

children.name: archive_cleanup_command
children.short_desc: Sets the shell command that will be executed at every restart point.

children.name: recovery_end_command
children.short_desc: Sets the shell command that will be executed once at the end of recovery.

children.name: restore_command
children.short_desc: Sets the shell command that will be called to retrieve an archived WAL file.

children.name: archive_command
children.extra_desc: This is used only if "archive_library" is not set.
children.short_desc: Sets the shell command that will be called to archive a WAL file.

children.name: archive_library
children.extra_desc: An empty string indicates that "archive_command" should be used.
children.short_desc: Sets the library that will be called to archive a WAL file.

children.name: archive_mode
children.short_desc: Allows archiving of WAL files using archive_command.

children.name: archive_timeout
children.short_desc: Sets the amount of time to wait before forcing a switch to the next WAL file.

children.name: checkpoint_completion_target
children.short_desc: Time spent flushing dirty buffers during checkpoint, as fraction of checkpoint interval.

children.name: checkpoint_flush_after
children.short_desc: Number of pages after which previously performed writes are flushed to disk.

children.name: checkpoint_timeout
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum time between automatic WAL checkpoints.

children.name: checkpoint_warning
children.extra_desc: Write a message to the server log if checkpoints caused by the filling of WAL segment files happen more frequently than this amount of time. Zero turns off the warning.
children.short_desc: Sets the maximum time before warning if checkpoints triggered by WAL volume happen too frequently.

children.name: max_wal_size
children.short_desc: Sets the WAL size that triggers a checkpoint.

children.name: min_wal_size
children.short_desc: Sets the minimum size to shrink the WAL to.

children.name: recovery_prefetch
children.extra_desc: Look ahead in the WAL to find references to uncached data.
children.short_desc: Prefetch referenced blocks during recovery.

children.name: wal_decode_buffer_size
children.extra_desc: Maximum distance to read ahead in the WAL to prefetch referenced data blocks.
children.short_desc: Buffer size for reading ahead in the WAL during recovery.

children.name: recovery_target
children.short_desc: Set to "immediate" to end recovery as soon as a consistent state is reached.

children.name: recovery_target_action
children.short_desc: Sets the action to perform upon reaching the recovery target.

children.name: recovery_target_inclusive
children.short_desc: Sets whether to include or exclude transaction with recovery target.

children.name: recovery_target_lsn
children.short_desc: Sets the LSN of the write-ahead log location up to which recovery will proceed.

children.name: recovery_target_name
children.short_desc: Sets the named restore point up to which recovery will proceed.

children.name: recovery_target_time
children.short_desc: Sets the time stamp up to which recovery will proceed.

children.name: recovery_target_timeline
children.short_desc: Specifies the timeline to recover into.

children.name: recovery_target_xid
children.short_desc: Sets the transaction ID up to which recovery will proceed.

children.name: commit_delay
children.short_desc: Sets the delay in microseconds between transaction commit and flushing WAL to disk.

children.name: commit_siblings
children.short_desc: Sets the minimum number of concurrent open transactions required before performing commit_delay.

children.name: fsync
children.extra_desc: The server will use the fsync() system call in several places to make sure that updates are physically written to disk. This ensures that a database cluster will recover to a consistent state after an operating system or hardware crash.
children.short_desc: Forces synchronization of updates to disk.

children.name: full_page_writes
children.extra_desc: A page write in process during an operating system crash might be only partially written to disk.  During recovery, the row changes stored in WAL are not enough to recover.  This option writes pages when first modified after a checkpoint to WAL so full recovery is possible.
children.short_desc: Writes full pages to WAL when first modified after a checkpoint.

children.name: synchronous_commit
children.short_desc: Sets the current transaction's synchronization level.

children.name: wal_after_error_sleep_delay
children.short_desc: Delay time after a WAL write error, in microseconds.

children.name: wal_buffers
children.short_desc: Sets the number of disk-page buffers in shared memory for WAL.

children.name: wal_compression
children.short_desc: Compresses full-page writes written in WAL file with specified method.

children.name: wal_init_zero
children.short_desc: Writes zeroes to new WAL files before first use.

children.name: wal_level
children.short_desc: Sets the level of information written to the WAL.

children.name: wal_log_hints
children.short_desc: Writes full pages to WAL when first modified after a checkpoint, even for a non-critical modification.

children.name: wal_recycle
children.short_desc: Recycles WAL files by renaming them.

children.name: wal_skip_threshold
children.short_desc: Minimum size of new file to fsync instead of writing WAL.

children.name: wal_sync_method
children.short_desc: Selects the method used for forcing WAL updates to disk.

children.name: wal_writer_delay
children.short_desc: Time between WAL flushes performed in the WAL writer.

children.name: wal_writer_flush_after
children.short_desc: Amount of WAL written out by WAL writer that triggers a flush.
